name: CBC-Anthropic-x-CDIS-Hackaton
description: Claude Code project manifest — inventories all MCP servers, skills, subagents, rules, and scripts installed in this project.

mcp_servers.description: External service connections available to all agents.
mcp_servers.notes: Auth tokens are placeholders — set real values as environment variables, never in source files.

skills.description: Slash-command skills available in this project. Located in .claude/skills/.

items.name: code-formatting
items.description: Cleans code with appropriate formatting, structure, and comments. Uses naming conventions, avoids complexity, and focuses on readability.

subagents.description: Specialised agents that handle distinct phases of the development workflow. Located in .claude/agents/subagents/.

items.name: agent-coordinator
items.role: Orchestrates the full development pipeline. Delegates to other subagents in order, tracks progress, surfaces blockers, and delivers the final output.

items.name: code-architect
items.role: Designs code structure, UI/UX, application capabilities, and acceptance criteria. Produces a specification — no implementation code.

items.name: code-engineer
items.role: Implements code from the architect's specification. Responsible for production-ready code, unit/integration tests, and the OWASP security checklist.

items.name: code-reviewer
items.role: Reviews code against the spec and all rules. Returns APPROVED, CHANGES REQUIRED, or BLOCKED. Last gate before shipping.

rules.description: Behavioural rules applied to all agents in priority order. Located in .claude/rules/.

priority_order.name: code-style
priority_order.description: Explanation format: analogy → comments → walkthrough → highlight. Applies to all code explanations.

priority_order.name: security
priority_order.description: MCP/API permission gating, mandatory caching with TTLs, mandatory rate limiting, and OWASP Top 10 review on every code change.

priority_order.name: testing
priority_order.description: Unit, integration, UAT, performance (100/1k/100k tiers), security, and E2E testing required for every feature.

priority_order.name: preferences
priority_order.description: Neat code, readable variable names, simple comments, best algorithms, and scalable design. Superseded by the three rules above.

scripts.description: Executable scripts Claude can run directly. Located in .claude/skills/scripts/.

items.name: validate
items.description: Validates source files against code-formatting standards. Checks file headers, magic numbers, function docs, indentation, line length, and debug statements.
